mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_video (store_id, user_id, title, file_url, cover_url, description, duration, file_size, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{fileUrl}, #{coverUrl}, #{description}, #{duration}, #{fileSize}, 'pending')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_video WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'approved'

SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.title, v.cover_url, v.description, v.duration, v.status, v.reject_reason, v.is_recommended, v.like_count, v.created_at, s.name AS author_name, s.avatar AS author_avatar, 0 AS liked FROM user_video v LEFT JOIN `user` s ON s.id = v.user_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY v.id DESC

SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.title, v.cover_url, v.description, v.duration, v.status, v.reject_reason, v.is_recommended, v.like_count, v.created_at, s.name AS author_name, s.avatar AS author_avatar, 0 AS liked FROM user_video v LEFT JOIN `user` s ON s.id = v.user_id WHERE v.store_id = #{storeId} AND v.status = #{status} ORDER BY FIELD(v.status,'pending','approved','rejected'), v.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_video SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count + #{delta} >= 0
UPDATE user_video SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, audit_admin_id = #{adminId}, audited_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE user_video SET is_recommended = #{recommended} WHERE id = #{id}
